newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Progressive 1st qtr sales down marginally.
newsitem.headline: Progressive 1st qtr sales down marginally.

text.p: Progressive Enterprises Ltd said on Thursday total group sales for the 13 weeks ended October 27 were NZ$517.98 million.
This was 0.5 percent below the first quarter of the previous year.
The company said when viewed on a comparable basis (removing the impact of store and restaurant openings and closures), group sales rose by 0.3 percent.

The supermarket operator's Foodtown chain continued to perform strongly, despite the loss of the Kelston store which was closed for re-development during the quarter. The new Foodtown Kelston began trading on November 4.
The performances of the Countdown/3 Guys and Rattrays chains, while below the previous year, were in line with expectations.

Sales from fast food chain Georgie Pie continued to fall following an the agreement to transfer a number of restaurants to burger chain McDonalds. The agreement is now unconditional and will result in the transfer of ownership of 17 restaurants.
